# Our Beauty Editor Put the Most Popular Allies of Skin Products to the Test—Here’s Her Honest Review

The skincare industry is an expansive one, with new product launches happening literally every day. While dermatologist-developed brands and tried-and-true ones always hold a special place in a well-rounded skincare routine, so do some of the more under-the-radar brands that are still gaining traction for their expertly crafted formulas, which truly deliver stellar results. Take [Allies of Skin](https://www.dermstore.com/c/brands/allies-of-skin/), for example. The super efficacious brand is designed to make skin care easier yet more effective with fewer steps, thanks to active ingredients at supercharged concentrations, allowing the skin to reap multiple benefits with a streamlined routine. These viral products and dermatologist favorites continue to raise the bar and set the standard, solidifying their position as serious players in the skin care industry.

Ahead, our resident beauty editor, Elise Tabin, gives a go to five of the brand’s most popular products that help to firm, brighten, clarify, and lift the skin, and shares her unfiltered review of the best Allies of Skin products.

* Skin Type: Combination

* Skin Concern(s): Redness, Discoloration, Fine Lines, Wrinkles, Breakouts

## About Allies of Skin

Allies of Skin is a beauty brand that prides itself on efficiency and efficacy. With a strong belief that everyone should feel empowered and beautiful in their own skin, the brand works hard to make beauty more human with fewer steps. Categorized as supercharged clinical skincare, Allies of Skin incorporates clinically proven active ingredients such as vitamin C, [growth factors](https://www.dermstore.com/blog/ingredient-index/growth-factors-for-skin/), and retinol to make skincare less complicated and far more streamlined, changing the status quo.

#### Quick Facts:

* Founder: Nicolas Travis
* Beauty Realm: Cleansers, Masks, Mists & Essences, Serums,  Moisturizers, Face Oils, Sunscreen
* Benefits: Anti-Aging, Antioxidant Protection, Brightening, Firming
* Derm-Recommended: Yes

## Benefits of Vitamin C Skin Care

Vitamin C is one of the most powerful ingredients in skincare, acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and brightening agent. It’s also known for its collagen-boosting capabilities to help maintain healthy, youthful skin. The skin is bombarded with numerous environmental aggressors on any given day, yet using [vitamin C](https://www.dermstore.com/blog/ingredient-index/vitamin-c-for-skin/) daily helps shield against them, keeping the skin supple, firm, bouncy, and evenly toned. Adding serums and creams with vitamin C, such as those from Allies of Skin, is essential for achieving younger-looking skin with a healthy glow and radiance.

The Texture: An oil-free serum that may feel oily at first but quickly dries down.

## Allies of Skin FAQs

### Do dermatologists recommend Allies of Skin?

Dermatologists often recommend ingredients such as [peptides](https://www.dermstore.com/c/ingredient/peptides/), [vitamin C](https://www.dermstore.com/c/ingredient/vitamin-c/), and [growth factors](https://www.dermstore.com/c/ingredient/growth-factors/), all of which are hero ingredients in the Allies of Skin line. The dermatologist-approved brand is one that they recommend patients use due to its pairing of scientifically proven ingredients at higher concentrations that are still safe for use on the skin.

### Is Allies of Skin medical-grade skincare?

Allies of Skin ticks off the boxes to be considered a medical-grade skincare brand. It incorporates higher-than-average concentrations of active ingredients and utilizes advanced delivery systems for effective results. The line also pairs nicely with in-office procedures, helping to encourage healthy healing.

### Is Allies of Skin good for mature skin?

The products within the Allies of Skin line are often recommended for mature and aging skin to help tackle common symptoms seen in these skin types. Featuring growth factors to initiate a healthy skin renewal cycle, peptides to firm the skin, and vitamin C to protect against free radical damage while encouraging [healthy collagen production](https://www.dermstore.com/blog/ingredient-index/collagen-skin-care/), the brand works especially well for mature skin, leaving it hydrated, protected, and rejuvenated so that it emerges more radiant and youthful.

## The Bottom Line

When it comes to high-performance skincare that delivers visible results and noticeable changes in the skin, Allies of Skin has staked its claim in the skincare arena. Featuring advanced, science-backed formulas at high concentrations that are safe for the skin, the brand is a must-have for achieving healthy, radiant, balanced skin. If you’re looking for products that really transform the skin for the better while strengthening overall skin health, Allies of Skin earns our editor’s stamp of approval.
